@about: The HVAC add-on's words (duct design). Sheet-metal terms: duct run, section, elbow, transition, reducer, tee, takeoff, lateral, bottom of duct, friction rate, equal friction, sheet metal area.
duct.name: Duct run
table.name: Duct schedule
table.title: Duct schedule
solid.name: Duct {tag}
@unit: Size units, airflow, velocity, friction rate, length and area, imperial (in) and metric (mm)
cmd.duct.help: Draw a duct run on its centerline: elbows, transitions and branch fittings come by themselves
cmd.ductsize.help: Size a section of a duct run from its airflow (equal friction), or type its size or shape
cmd.ductcalc.help: Duct calculator: the round, rectangular and flat oval sizes for an airflow at a friction rate
cmd.ductsched.help: The duct schedule: lengths, fittings and sheet metal area, placed as a table that keeps itself up to date
cmd.duct3d.help: Build the solids of every duct run on the 3D tab again
ask.duct.first: First point of the duct run ({size}); start inside a duct to branch from it
ask.duct.next: Next point ({size}); end inside a duct to connect to it
ask.ductsize: Section {size}: size it from its airflow, type a size, or change its shape
ask.which: Change this section or the whole run
ask.table: Where the schedule goes (its top left corner)
done.table: Schedule placed. It follows the ducts as they change.
done.3d: Solids built again for {n} duct runs.
done.3d.off: Solids are switched off in Settings › CadCraft › HVAC.
sched.total: Ducts: {len} {lu} straight, {n} fittings, {area} {au} of sheet metal.
calc.exact: {q} {qu} at {rate} {ru} in {mat}: a round duct of {d} {unit} exactly.
warn.aspect: Its sides are {a} to 1: more than 4 to 1 costs more sheet metal and pressure; consider a taller duct.
warn.short: A section is too short for its fittings: they overlap. Move a point or use smaller elbows.
warn.hairpin: The run turns back on itself at a corner: no elbow can be drawn there.
warn.maxpts: A run holds up to 100 points: this one ends here. Start a new run from its end.
err.size: That is not a size: type width × height (24x12) or a diameter (14).
err.sized: No duct size carries that airflow at that friction rate.
err.run: That run cannot be drawn: it needs two different points and a size for each section.
err.notduct: That is not a duct run.
err.newer: This run was made by a newer HVAC add-on: it is left as it is.
err.noducts: There are no duct runs in the drawing.
export.takeoff: Ducts for TakeoffCraft (PDF with the takeoff inside)
pack.name: Ducts in {name}
pack.description: The duct and fitting assemblies of one CadCraft drawing, with the sheet metal each needs. No rates: set your own.
pack.assume.duct: Sheet metal = the duct's perimeter × its length; seams, laps and waste are not included: add them as waste.
pack.assume.fitting: Sheet metal per fitting = its perimeter × its centerline length (exact for radius elbows; close for transitions).
pack.source.drawn: Sheet metal worked out from the drawn sizes: perimeter × centerline length
panel.facts: {n} duct runs: {len} {lu} straight, {f} fittings, {area} {au} of sheet metal.
panel.none: No duct runs yet: type DUCT.
set.h: Height for sizing rectangular and flat oval ducts ({unit})
set.z: Bottom of duct for new runs ({unit})
